label: dense near-always-on candidate feature (mild boost after early e/b inputs)
explanation: Fires on ~95% of all steps in every sequence, across all phases, positions, lengths and tokens. No variable gives lift above about 1.1x (t=0 fires at 100%). The trivial predicate t >= 0 gets F1 0.97 on dev, but only because the feature is nearly always on, so it explains nothing. The only structure seen is in magnitude: the largest activations come early in the original phase (t=2-4, which holds the most mass) when the sequence starts with repeated e or b tokens (e.g. e e e, 3 e e b). Even then the predicate phase0 & seen(e or b) has precision 0.99 but only 0.17 mass recall. No clean boolean description of where it fires or does not fire.
